Why distribute SeeMyHealth

A complete ecosystem, not just a device

Most wearable brands sell one product. SeeMyHealth offers a full, connected ecosystem — Ring One, Smart Scale, BP Monitor, and Smart Flask — giving distributors a broader range to place and a stronger story to tell.

Broad market appeal

SeeMyHealth is designed for everyone from everyday wellness seekers to athletes, healthcare patients, and corporate wellness programs — which means more channels, more customers, and more opportunity for your business.

Who We’re Looking For

We're looking for partners who mean It

We don't work with distributors — we work with partners. The best fit is someone who understands their market, believes in what they're selling, and wants to build something long-term.

01 — 05Prev/Next

  • Retail & E-Commerce

    Electronics retailers, health and wellness stores, pharmacies, and online marketplace operators looking to add a high-demand, high-differentiation product to their catalogue.

  • Healthcare Distributors

    Medical device and health equipment distributors with established relationships across clinics, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, and specialist practices.

  • Corporate Wellness Providers

    Companies that design and deliver employee wellness programs, benefits platforms, or occupational health services — and are looking for hardware to anchor their offering.

  • Regional Distributors

    Operators with strong local or regional market knowledge seeking exclusive or semi-exclusive distribution rights to represent SeeMyHealth within a defined territory.

What You Get

  • Competitive margins

    Our wholesale pricing is structured to give distributors meaningful margin at both standard and volume tiers — with incentive programs for partners who grow with us.

  • Dedicated account management

    Every SeeMyHealth distribution partner gets a dedicated account manager — a single point of contact for orders, support, escalations, and strategic planning.

  • Ready-to-use marketing assets

    From product photography and brand guidelines to sales decks and digital ad creatives, we provide a full library of co-brandable materials ready to deploy in your market.

  • Product training & certification

    Your sales team will receive structured onboarding, product knowledge training, and access to our certification program — so they can speak confidently about what they're selling.

  • Early access to new products

    Distribution partners get priority notification and early access to new product launches — including the upcoming SeeMyHealth Glucometer — before they're available to the general market.

  • Co-marketing opportunities

    For high-performing partners, we offer joint campaign support, co-branded activations, and the opportunity to be featured as a certified SeeMyHealth distribution partner across our channels.
